Class Main

java.lang.Object
javafx.application.Application
Main
Direct Known Subclasses:
InventoryApp
public class Main extends javafx.application.Application
Modern JavaFX Graphical User Interface for the Store Inventory Management System. Implements interactive item registration, live inventory table viewing, real-time search filtering, stock status classification, KPI statistics cards, and complete input validation according to CLO-5.
Version:
1.0
Author:
Haseeb Ahmad
